items.title: Did Raised Guidance Just Shift Eaton (ETN) Investment Narrative?
items.summary: Eaton reported third quarter 2026 sales of US$8.95b and net income of US$1.08b, affirmed its dividend, and issued earnings guidance for the fourth quarter and full year 2026. The company highlighted strong data center related demand and recent acquisitions aligned with power and cooling for these facilities, pointing to data infrastructure as a key earnings driver.
